newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung passes on 54,500T soy/corn tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung passes on 54,500T soy/corn tender.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung Group on Friday passed on a tender for combined shipments comprising 38,500 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn due to high bid prices, traders said.

Best offers in the Hui Shung Group's corn import tender were $123.62 per tonne FOB from the Gulf of Mexico and US$134.56 FOB from the Pacific Northwest. The best cost-and-freight corn offer was US$147.20 per tonne.

Best offers in the group's soybean tender were US$293.67 per tonne FOB from the Gulf of Mexico and US$303.00 per tonne from the Pacific Northwest. The best cost-and-freight soybean offer was US$316.77 per tonne.
The Hui Shung Group includes Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp, Eagle Food Industry and Charoen Pokphand.
